subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository approve these exact third-party action revisions for execution in workflows that receive GitHub App private keys, registry credentials, or OpenAI API keys?
rationale: This is a supply-chain trust decision about external code running with repository credentials; source inspection cannot establish the repository’s acceptable-action policy or trust posture.

options.title: Approve pinned revisions after review
options.body: A workflow-security owner verifies the exact upstream revisions and accepts the credential-bearing execution boundary, with final-head runtime evidence attached.

options.title: Split sensitive action updates
options.body: Land only action updates outside credential-bearing workflows and defer the token, registry, and Codex-action revisions to a separately approved security review.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Close or defer this grouped Dependabot update until a maintainer wants to refresh the approved external-action set.

recommendation.title: Approve pinned revisions after review
recommendation.body: A workflow-security owner verifies the exact upstream revisions and accepts the credential-bearing execution boundary, with final-head runtime evidence attached.

likelyOwner.reason: It is the only identified review participant with direct context on the unresolved workflow-security gate; the decision itself should be escalated to the responsible human workflow-security owner.
